name: Hariom Singh
tagline: One creator. Every kind of story.
intro: I'm a content creator making reels, vlogs, poetry and promotional content. From open mic stages to music, entertainment and sports events, I turn what I see and feel into content people connect with.

about.title: Hi, I’m Hariom
paragraphs: My creative journey began with writing poetry, where I discovered my love for expressing emotions through words. Gradually, I started bringing those words to life through videos, reels, and storytelling. Over the past 2–3 years, content creation has become my way of exploring ideas, capturing moments, and connecting with people. What drives me is the freedom to create and turn ordinary experiences into stories that make people feel something.

From fun and relatable reels, lifestyle vlogs, and poetry to open mics, event promotions, and brand collaborations, I love experimenting with different forms of storytelling. Whether I'm making someone laugh, sharing an experience, performing on stage, or bringing a brand's story to life, I believe every piece of content should have its own personality and connect with its audience.
about.quote: Funny, filmy & a little too honest.

poems.title: फूल और कांटे
poems.lines:
मुझे सोना पसंद है नींद बहुत आती है 
ख़ुदसे नफ़रत है थोड़ी ज़्यादा 
लोगो से उम्मीद हो जाती है 

फुलो में गुलाब पर मुझे कांटे पसंद है 
गुलाबो से कम जख्म दे जाते हैं
मैं खुली किताब, सबको बंद पसंद आती है

poems.title: अंधेरा
poems.lines:
तुम जब गौर करोगी तो तुम्हें पता चलेगा ,
ये अँधेरा अन्तर्मन का है, और अंतर्मन के अँधेरे में कुछ नहीं निकलता।
